- When sentiment is strongly positive (≥ 0.67) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 1–3% for next 5–10 days.  
- When sentiment is strongly negative (≤ -0.33), model often underestimates; add 1–3% to forecast for next 5–10 days.  
- After a sharp price spike (forecast > 73.0), model frequently overcorrects downward; cap forecast at 72.5–73.5 for next 3–5 days.  
- Model consistently underestimates early in the 30-day horizon (first 5–7 days); add 0.5–1.5% to first 5 forecasts.  
- If sentiment shows strong reversal (e.g., 0.67 → -0.33), model often fails to adjust; apply mean reversion to last 3–5 data points before forecast.  
- When sentiment is neutral (0.00–0.33), model tends to lag; forecast should be adjusted upward by 0.5–1.0% for next 3–7 days.
